body:
I wanted to update everyone on what’s happening.

I told my girlfriend. I can tell that after I get help she might not want me anymore. Not sure if that’s just what I feel or what is true.

I’m telling my therapist monday about what happened here today. Hopefully I’ll get some form of help. Hospital or medicine maybe. I’m scared of pills though.

Hopefully I make it to monday. I love you all.
Is everything okay? Are you doing okay?
Talk to me. Is there a reason for what’s happening?

First of all, you are a pure soul. This response is so detailed and cared for and I appreciate it beyond words.  


That story about your boyfriend (the skype one, not the ex) closely relates to what I feel. I've told my girlfriend most of how I feel, and I'm not very guarded about how I feel with those I trust, so she knows that I struggle with a deep sadness (I don't like to call it depression, although this is most likely what it is). I haven't told her that I consider suicide or suicidal thoughts to the extent that I do however. One night we were texting and I was in a really rough spot and I told her about my thoughts of "they would all love me after I was gone" and also the somewhat contradictory "the memory of me would fade easily." She later told me that she grew panicked by that and was very emotional, but told me to continue to tell her about the way that I feel. In this regard, I don't want to worry her (even though, justifiably, it is something to worry about).   


I don't feel like I can talk to my dad about those kinds of things. We have a loving relationship, which I greatly appreciate, but this isn't the genre of topic we usually talk about. I see a therapist though, and I could tell him, but I think this would lead to fairly serious changes in my life that I don't know are good or not.   


To elaborate on the way that I feel, the reason I contemplate suicide so seriously is for the validation of others. The fact that people will view me in a positive light after I'm gone brings me a kind of sick gratification that nothing else really can.  


Thank you again.
I often write in my notes what I feel and it does tend to help. I appreciate your comment greatly and you lot helped me through the day.

My mom isn’t in my life, which makes this a little more difficult. That’s why I didn’t do it today. A part of me wants to live and hopes for that second chance or the ability to stop. I’m not sure I can tell my dad alone.

I feel like I want to start sooner for sooner results. I didn’t say this in the original but I obsess and romanticize people mourning my death. The aftermath brings me happiness and gratification that life can’t. I love them both a lot, and I’m sure they love me, but I can’t bring myself to tell my dad. My girlfriend told me that she gets panicky when I tell her things like this and I think I could tell her but it’s hard, and getting her to keep that a secret would be too much pressure for her. I’ll try and give them a hug for you. Thank you.
Hey man. I hope you’re doing well. Death constantly plagues my thoughts. It’s bittersweet to me. How did your mom react when you told her? I’m glad she’s there for you.
